src: The tumour is an invasive breast carcinoma of no special type with extensive lymphovascular invasion.
The tumour was estrogen receptor positive (Allred score 8) and HER2-low (IHC 1+), with a Ki-67 index of 30%.
Two sentinel lymph nodes contained micrometastases, and a third showed isolated tumor cells.
On core needle biopsy, a cellular fibroadenoma can be difficult to distinguish from a benign phyllodes tumor.
The patient achieved a pathologic complete response after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

src: Triple-negative tumours were less frequent than luminal A tumours in this cohort.
Mammography showed fine pleomorphic microcalcifications classified as BI-RADS 4.
Atypical ductal hyperplasia was seen adjacent to the invasive lobular carcinoma.
